faq.question: Who do you work with?
faq.answer: Independent and self-published authors of fiction and nonfiction: first-time authors preparing to publish, published authors whose books are hard to find, and authors planning a launch, a relaunch or a long-term platform.

faq.question: Do I need to know which service I need?
faq.answer: No. Tell us about the book and the result you want. We assess where it stands and recommend the right first step, often a single discipline rather than a full package.

faq.question: How much does it cost?
faq.answer: Every engagement is scoped to the book. After your consultation you receive a written proposal with the work, the timeline and the fee, before any paid work begins. Advertising budgets are always kept separate from our fees.

faq.question: Do you guarantee results?
faq.answer: No honest house can. Results depend on the book, the market, timing and platforms. What we do commit to, in writing, is a clear scope, named specialists, defined deliverables and agreed review points.

faq.question: Who will work on my book?
faq.answer: The specialists best suited to your book’s needs. You will know exactly who is responsible for each part of the work before it begins.

faq.question: Who owns the work?
faq.answer: You keep the rights to your manuscript and any material you already own. Ownership and usage rights for commissioned work, such as a cover or a website, are set out in your project agreement.

faq.question: Can I get a refund?
faq.answer: Refunds depend on your signed project agreement, the work already completed and any third-party costs already committed. Approved third-party expenses are generally non-refundable.

faq.question: Do you work with authors outside the United States?
faq.answer: Yes. We work remotely, so authors can work with us wherever they live, and this site is available in twelve languages.

faq.question: How soon will I hear back?
faq.answer: Within two business days of sending your consultation request.
